categories.title: Mental & Emotional Strength
categories.description: Understand your emotional capacity and regulation

questions.text: What emotion shows up most often in your daily life?
When you feel overwhelmed, what does that feel like in your body?
What situation makes you feel most out of control emotionally?
When you feel stressed or upset, what actually helps you calm down?
Is there any emotion you try to push away or not feel?
How do people usually know you're struggling emotionally?
What emotion scares you the most or makes you uncomfortable?
Do you have someone safe to talk to about your feelings?
How long does it usually take you to feel better after something upsets you?
What would feeling emotionally strong look like for you?

categories.title: Self-Worth & Inner Safety
categories.description: Understand self-belief and your inner dialogue

questions.text: What's the main criticism you have about yourself?
When you make a mistake, what's your first thought about yourself?
Do you feel you need to achieve things to be worthy, or do you have worth already?
Who do you compare yourself to the most, and how does that make you feel?
What part of yourself do you try to hide from others?
When someone compliments you, what goes through your mind?
If you failed at something important, how would that change how you see yourself?
What did your family teach you about being good enough?
How much of your worth comes from what you achieve versus who you are?
What would it feel like to accept yourself exactly as you are right now?

categories.title: Goals & Life Direction
categories.description: Clarity on where you're heading and what matters

questions.text: What do you actually want to be doing with your life? (Be honest, not what you should want)
What's stopping you from pursuing that right now?
Are you following your own goals or someone else's expectations?
If no one was judging you, what would you pursue?
What feels missing or wrong in your life currently?
Imagine your life in 5 years being really good. What does that look like?
What success would you regret NOT going for?
What's one thing you know you should do but keep avoiding?
How clear are you on what actually matters to you versus what you've been told matters?
What would change if you gave yourself permission to want what you want?

categories.title: Decision-Making & Thinking Style
categories.description: Understand your mental patterns and how you think

questions.text: What decision are you struggling with right now?
Why is this decision hard? What are you worried might happen?
How much information do you need before you feel ready to decide?
Do you trust your own judgment, or do you doubt yourself?
When you've made decisions before, do you stick with them or second-guess?
What's the worst thing you think could happen if you choose wrong?
Are you waiting for the perfect choice, or willing to choose even if it's not perfect?
Who influences your decisions the most - you or others?
Looking back, have your 'bad' decisions actually been as bad as you feared?
What decision would change your life if you finally made it?

categories.title: Energy & Daily Life
categories.description: Understand your lifestyle and what drains/energizes you

questions.text: What's draining your energy the most right now?
What genuinely refills or restores you?
How much sleep and rest are you getting versus what you actually need?
What are you saying yes to that you actually want to say no to?
When was the last time you felt rested and energized?
What are you doing out of obligation versus what you actually want to do?
Do you have time for things that matter to you, or is it all just survival mode?
What would change if you actually prioritized your own needs?
What's one thing you would stop doing if you could?
What would sustainable energy and balance actually look like for you?

categories.title: Support, Connection & Safety
categories.description: Understand your relationships and support system

questions.text: Who do you feel most and least connected to right now?
What makes it hard for you to be close to people?
Have you been hurt in relationships before? How does that affect you now?
What do you need from others that you're not getting?
Do you tend to push people away or hold on too tight?
How safe do you feel being your real self with others?
What do you wish someone understood about you?
When you need support, do you ask for it or suffer alone?
What would real connection look like for you?
What's one relationship you'd like to improve, and what's in the way?

categories.title: Meaning, Values & Life Purpose
categories.description: Understand what gives your life meaning and purpose

questions.text: What gives your life meaning right now? (If nothing, what used to?)
Do you feel your life matters, or does it feel empty?
What do you believe you're here on earth to do or become?
Are you living in alignment with what's important to you?
What would you do with your life if you knew you couldn't fail?
Who or what do you want to help or contribute to?
What part of yourself do you hide to fit in or be accepted?
When was the last time you felt like you were exactly where you needed to be?
What impact or legacy do you want to leave behind?
What would it take for you to feel like your life was truly lived?

categories.title: Habit Breaking & Change
categories.description: Understand your patterns and ability to change behaviors

questions.text: What specific behavior do you want to change or break?
How long has this been a struggle for you?
What does this habit give you that you're not getting elsewhere?
What have you tried before to break it, and why didn't it work?
What's the real cost of this habit to your life?
When does the urge hit strongest? What's happening right before?
How do you feel about yourself because of this habit?
Do you believe you can actually change this, or does it feel impossible?
What would you need - structure, accountability, tools, or something else?
If you broke this habit, what would actually change in your life?
